summary: AI safety dominates the day as OpenAI halts a risky model and DeepMind's founder steps back, while war, disaster and industry news round out a busy news cycle.

items.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
items.description: OpenAI paused development of its Astra model after finding it could independently launch cyberattacks, a stark warning about AI's offensive potential.

items.title: Child among three killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv
items.description: Russian missile strikes near Kyiv killed a child and two others, underscoring Ukraine's dwindling air-defence supplies.

items.title: Besieged Sudanese city faces relentless drone strikes and risk of mass atrocities, U.N. warns
items.description: The U.N. warns that drone strikes and disease are pushing Sudan's besieged el-Obeid toward mass atrocities.

items.title: Google DeepMind enters a new era as co-founder Demis Hassabis shifts AI role
items.description: Demis Hassabis is stepping back from Google DeepMind's helm, fueling concern the lab is losing research independence to commercial pressure.

items.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay additional $567M in child safety case
items.description: A New Mexico court hit Meta with another $567 million penalty in a child-safety case, pushing its total fine past $900 million.

items.title: Hormuz talks positive, Oman says, as Iran warns deal would not open strait
items.description: Oman says talks over the Strait of Hormuz are moving positively, though Iran still won't guarantee the waterway stays open.

items.title: ByteDance trains massive AI model in bid to rival Anthropic
items.description: ByteDance is training a 10-trillion-parameter model as it races to challenge Anthropic in the frontier AI arms race.

items.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
items.description: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan signed a mutual-defence pact treating an attack on one as an attack on all, amid Middle East tensions.

items.title: Why Google DeepMind broke up the AlphaFold team
items.description: Google DeepMind disbanded its AlphaFold team after largely solving protein structure prediction, handing the torch to outside researchers.

items.title: AI just created a virus not found in nature, and scientists are worried
items.description: Scientists used AI to design a virus not found in nature, raising hope for new antibiotics and fears of misuse.

items.title: Take-Two boss "not in the least" concerned bad press around Rockstar's employment tribunal will affect GTA 6 launch
items.description: Take-Two's CEO says bad press over Rockstar's labor tribunal won't dent the marketing push toward GTA 6's launch.

items.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
items.description: A planned Amazon data center in Texas could become the single largest source of climate pollution in the U.S.

items.title: Fast-moving Canada wildfire doubles in size forcing thousands to flee homes
items.description: A fast-moving wildfire in British Columbia has doubled in size, forcing thousands to flee as it remains out of control.

items.title: Sony appears to be putting labels on PS5 console boxes to warn people it's ending disc production
items.description: Sony is now warning buyers on PS5 boxes that the console will stop supporting physical discs starting in 2028.

items.title: Typhoon Dolphin batters Japan's Okinawa before bearing down on China
items.description: Typhoon Dolphin has cut power to tens of thousands in Okinawa before turning toward China.

items.title: The White House’s plan to vet potentially dangerous AI is cloaked in secrecy
items.description: The Trump administration finalized a secretive framework for vetting AI models' safety and cybersecurity risks, drawing transparency concerns.

items.title: NASA’s Voyager 2 survives daring ‘big bang’ maneuver
items.description: NASA pulled off a daring maneuver to keep Voyager 2 running nearly 49 years after launch despite fading power.

items.title: Thai PM vows to introduce stricter gun laws after eight killed in shooting
items.description: Thailand's prime minister promised stricter gun laws after a 14-year-old killed eight people in a shooting spree.

items.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
items.description: OpenAI acquired presentation startup NextSlide, folding its team into ChatGPT's product work.

items.title: Indie game publisher Devolver Digital wants to go private
items.description: Indie publisher Devolver Digital is seeking to go private after a rocky stretch as a public company.

items.title: Did life on Earth only arise once? Perhaps not
items.description: New research suggests the last common ancestor of life on Earth may not have been alive at all, challenging assumptions about life's origin.

items.title: DeepMind’s hurricane breakthrough has surprised weather scientists
items.description: DeepMind's open WeatherNext model is surprising scientists with accurate hurricane forecasts from lower-resolution data.

items.title: Neutrinos From Deep Inside Earth Provide a New Picture of the Mantle
items.description: A global network of neutrino detectors is giving scientists a new view of the radioactive elements powering Earth's mantle.

items.title: Extraction shooter BR1 Infinite is paying players for every in-game kill, drawing concerns about gambling and cheating
items.description: New extraction shooter BR1 Infinite pays players for every kill, sparking worries about gambling incentives and cheating.

items.title: AI chatbots have failed people in crisis. Can that be fixed?
items.description: Clinicians say AI chatbots have repeatedly failed people in mental-health crises, and want companies to open up safety data.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day multiplayer beta blows past series' records on Steam
items.description: Gears of War: E-Day's open beta has already shattered the series' concurrent-player records on Steam.

items.title: The Witcher season 5 delayed on Netflix, new report says
items.description: Netflix has quietly pushed The Witcher's fifth and final season back to 2027.

items.title: Tripledot Studios acquires Supersonic from Unity for $40m
items.description: Tripledot Studios bought mobile publisher Supersonic from Unity for $40 million, consolidating mobile game publishing.

items.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber Is ‘Gutted’ on ‘Cats: The Jellicle Ball’ Closing Night: Producing on Broadway Is ‘Unsustainable’
items.description: Andrew Lloyd Webber says he's 'gutted' as Cats: The Jellicle Ball closes, calling Broadway production economics unsustainable.

items.title: Matt Damon’s 113-Minute 10/10 Action Thriller Officially Crowned as Netflix’s Biggest Movie of 2026
items.description: Matt Damon's action thriller has been crowned Netflix's most-streamed movie of 2026 with over 4.4 billion minutes watched.
